paper_title: Incorporating Domain Knowledge into Materials Tokenization
caption: Comparison of Macro-F1 scores for MATTER and w/o material knowledge across during tokenization training different number of tokens.
model_annotation:
Here's a paragraph describing the plot, adhering to the provided guidelines:

This plot illustrates the Macro-F1 score for two conditions across a range of number of tokens. The x-axis is labeled "Number of tokens" and is linear, ranging from 0.6 to 1.4 with tick labels at 0.6, 0.8, 1.0, 1.2, and 1.4. The y-axis is labeled "Macro-F1 Score (%)" and is linear, ranging from 48 to 58. The first line, in pink with circular markers and a solid style, represents MATTER (ours), starting at approximately 52.3% at 0.6 tokens, rising to a peak of approximately 57.2% at 1.0 tokens, then declining to approximately 49.5% at 1.4 tokens. The second line, in blue with circular markers and a solid style, represents w/o material information, beginning around 52.1% at 0.6 tokens, fluctuating between 51.8% and 53.6% until the end, ending with a value of approximately 52.4% at 1.4 tokens.
